classification_reasons: The exercise is a ballistic plyometric bound with a flight phase, alternating push-off legs and a diagonal side-to-side path. None of the movement families (squat, hip_hinge, push/pull, carry, or single-joint families) is an exact fit. Choosing squat, knee_extension or ankle_plantarflexion would be a nearest-but-wrong category.

Laterality cannot be represented faithfully. Each rep drives off one leg and the swing leg drives the opposite knee up, then the roles reverse. The schema's 'unilateral', 'left' and 'right' would count limb actions on only one side, and 'bilateral' would imply simultaneous two-leg work.
The kinetic chain alternates between closed chain (ground push-off) and open chain (swing-leg knee drive in flight). The schema allows only one kinetic_chain_type.
The two still frames do not show the full diagonal landing and push-off path, and the stance/swing roles and lateral hip actions cannot be resolved from them.
